action: Cuts the sphere with polyline planar cuts (on-screen label 'SLICE Angle=13'), several straight segments in one stroke, producing a faceted head block with a flat face, brow and jaw planes.
tool: Curve planar cut, label 'SLICE' (TrimCurve/SliceCurve family on his shelf, exact brush inferred)
why: Get hard anime planes (face front, cheek, jaw, brow) in a few cuts before any soft sculpting.
reader_equivalent: Bisect with Fill / Boolean plane cuts, or Line Project / Box Trim in sculpt mode; then voxel remesh.

action: Softens the faceted block into a head and pushes in eye sockets, nose wedge, and a pointed chin; adds an ear bump on the side.
why: Move from blocky planes to soft forms while keeping the cut planes.
reader_equivalent: Voxel remesh then Grab, Clay Strips, Smooth.

action: Sculpts a scrunched angry/crying face: deep carved upper-lid lines, many pinched glabella and nose-bridge wrinkles, strokes radiating over the forehead, pouting lips, with Zmenos (subtract) active.
tool: Carving brush in Zmenos mode, DynaMesh
why: Expression is built from many sharp line grooves around the eyes and nose.
reader_equivalent: Crease / Draw Sharp with subtract on, Pinch for ridges, voxel remesh.

action: Draws dark line-art strokes and flat dark bands (stripes over the face) on the sculpt; a color picker is visible.
why: Mark the manga-style lines and the yokai stripes as a guide.
reader_equivalent: Texture Paint / Vertex Paint guide lines.

action: Uses an IMM brush (caption 'IMM Brush', 'IMM Brush hair: SK_Hair') to lay hair locks on the head following a red guide curve.
why: Insert ready-made lock meshes along curves instead of sculpting each lock.
reader_equivalent: Curve with bevel/taper or Geometry Nodes curve-to-mesh lock along a drawn curve; or Insert of a lock asset.

action: Finished Okarun yokai form in a sepia render and a full-body back/side turnaround: flame-like separate hair locks, round glasses, oversized teeth, scarf with folds.
